paragraphs: (a) This chapter applies only to a municipality\[<del>:</del>
<ins>(1)</ins> \[<del>(A)</del>\] has a population of <ins>25,000</ins> \[<del>10,000</del>\] or more; <ins>and</ins>
<ins>(2)</ins> \[<del>(B)</del>\] has a paid fire department or police department\[<del>; and</del>
\[<del>(C) has voted to adopt this chapter or the law codified by this chapter; or</del>

\[<del>(2) whose election to adopt this chapter and whose acts subsequent to that election were validated by the law enacted by House Bill 822, Acts of the 73rd Legislature, Regular Session, 1993</del>\].
